source_pages: All 15 English solution pages, including original Cyrillic running-page labels and all grading tables.
source_design: Every prose slot uses its original source baseline, size, serif/sans family, actual weight and italic treatment. Korean uses pinned official Noto CJK Regular/Bold counterparts; supported native Latin characters retain the original positive PDF Widths. No shrinking, wrapping, paragraph merging or new mathematical images.
native_math: All original mathematical glyphs, symbols, SI units, formula numbers, font programs, CMaps, sizes and baselines remain native. Existing 2x2 color carriers and their alpha SMask streams are original PDF objects: raw/decoded bytes, filters, image geometry, transforms and all visible alpha ink are verified unchanged.
figures: Original mechanical diagrams, Earth illustration, atmosphere model, spectral graphs and lens diagrams are preserved. Their labels are mathematical variables and physical values. Native English Side view/Top view captions on page4 are translated as prose; no bitmap language overlay is necessary in this edition.
language_review: All prose, headings, grading descriptions, original Cyrillic page labels, short conjunctions and i.e. are translated. Remaining Latin words Pa and mathematical functions are protected SI units/functions. Roman XVIII and diagram variables retain source notation.
source_numeric_discrepancies: Original body and grading-table values differ in the greenhouse subproblem, including alpha, K(t0), and the temperature changes. Original formula typography and every numerical value are retained exactly; no editorial correction or erratum is added to the PDF.
selected_prose_whitespace: No relaxed whitespace journal is used in this edition; every unselected actual source whitespace glyph remains native and is checked under the ordinary strict geometry criteria.
